targets.expected_type: ∀ (s : Commonwealth.Server.State), Commonwealth.Server.fresh s = true ↔ s.locked = some (Commonwealth.Server.stamp s)
∀ (s after : Commonwealth.Server.State) (voter : String) (eligible present : Bool), Commonwealth.Server.step s (.cast voter eligible present) = some after → Commonwealth.Server.fresh s = true
∀ (s after : Commonwealth.Server.State) (clerkIndependent quorum : Bool), Commonwealth.Server.step s (.review clerkIndependent quorum) = some after → Commonwealth.Server.fresh s = true
∀ (s : Commonwealth.Server.State) (voter : String) (eligible present : Bool), voter ∈ s.castBy → Commonwealth.Server.step s (.cast voter eligible present) = none
